name: Egelsbach (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of green edged on both sides by narrow white stripes, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Egelsbach (a red heart and oak leaves on white).
history: The flags were approved for the municipality by the Hessian Minister of the Interior on 31 March 1966, described as the arms on a green cloth bordered on both sides by a narrow white stripe.

features.role: Egelsbach arms — heart and oak leaves on white
